event_name: Date 18 June 2022 Time 20:26 2022 CANADIAN GRAND PRIX 16 - 19 June 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 47) and heard from the driver and team representative, have considered the following matter, and determine
fact: Failure to follow item 14 of the Race Director's Event Notes.
offence: Breach of Article 12.2.1.i) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
penalty: Reprimand for the driver. This is the driver's 1st Reprimand of the season (Driving).
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 24 (Zhou Guanyu) and team representative and reviewed video evidence. Car 24 left the track at turn 9 and failed to keep completely to the left of the orange bollard before re-joining the track. The driver explained that due to the climate conditions (rain) he was not sure if he could stay to the left of the bollard and that therefore he did not comply with the Race Director's instructions in this instance. The Stewards determine that this is a breach of the above regulation by car 24.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 24 Failure To Follow Rd Event Notes
